items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know afterwards you made one with Tal Farlow, I think. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. 'Jarm', that was on that album.

ctx.x: Yeah... Well, I told Alfred that I was doing a date with that particular band. So he sounded me whether I'd want to do a date for Blue Note with that band. Shit, I said, 'Why not? Let's see what we can get going.' And I made two or three albums with Blue Note.
I know afterwards you made one with Tal Farlow, I think.
Yeah. 'Jarm', that was on that album. And we made a thing with Kenny Drew. Is that the one...?
